edges.target_label: RoboTTT: Context Scaling for Robot Policies (2026)
edges.note: Where standard TTT adapts a model to a single test instance with a few gradient steps, RoboTTT uses the same fast-weight update as a policy's working memory across thousands of steps.

edges.source_label: Uncertainty Quantification for Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Models (2026)
edges.target_label: RoboTTT: Context Scaling for Robot Policies (2026)
edges.note: Building on recent Vision-Language-Action policy work in the library, RoboTTT embeds Test-Time Training inside the VLA policy to hold long visuomotor history in weight space.
Sun made the test-time update mechanism internal to the model; TTPO makes the update objective self-supplied by removing the label.
Akyurek built the test-time supervision signal from constructed augmentations of the target task; TTPO builds it from the model rollout distribution instead.
DeepSeek-R1 established reinforcement learning against a verifiable reward, and therefore the dependence on labels that TTPO removes by substituting a majority vote.
Tang treated agreement across samples as a usable signal rather than a decoding heuristic; TTPO turns that agreement into a training target and splits it into a positive and a negative branch.

edges.note: The survey catalogued memory in foundation agents as retrieval over a passive record; Safin-1 makes the state writable for a second purpose, so it holds a capability rather than only a record.

edges.note: Sun placed a learned state inside the layer and updated it at inference on the current input, then discarded it; MARCH keeps the adapted state across interactions, moving the unit of adaptation from a sequence to a deployment.
